'''Cordgrass''' was a type of [[Grass/Legends|grass]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kabal/Legends|Kabal]]. The [[Plant/Legends|plant]] was distinguished by its durable, sinewy stalks, which could be used as [[Rope/Legends|rope]].<ref name="FP">{{GamerCite|1|Fair Prey}}</ref>
